body:
GitHub beamfall/corvint#778, filed by the owner 2026-10-11. 

## Problem
A screen graph is only useful for "enter directly" if each screen's template actually loads by URL for the declared role and data state. Abstract states, required resolves, parent-only params and guard redirects mean a template is often not a valid entry. Teams keep hand-maintained "URL that loads" lists that drift.

## Proposal
- Static: `flows appmap entries --map FILE` classifying each screen `deep-linkable | requires-parent-params | abstract | guarded(permission/flag) | UNKNOWN`, with the minimal parameter set and the shortest PROVEN edge path from an entry screen.
- Runtime (opt-in, trusted local app, read effect only): visit each candidate entry with a declared fixture/session and record `loads | redirected(to screen) | error`, emitting receipts consumable by the edge ledger.

## Acceptance criteria
- Runtime mode refuses any screen whose entry is not effect class `read`.
- Results are revision-bound; a template or guard change flips the result to UNVERIFIED_AT_HEAD.
- Projection lists per screen: entry URL template, required params, guard, last verified revision.
